Market today: The mood is tense. Rising Treasury yields and higher Fed rate hike odds are the real drivers, directly threatening your growth-heavy tech and chip names. Inflationary pressures from oil aren't helping.

Your holdings: SOXL (-53.44%) and SPAL (-32.15%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and margin amplifies these deep drawdowns. SMH (-11.37%) and QQQI (-3.81%) also need attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields and any further Fed commentary. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for any signs of further breakdown.

Bottom line: Protect your capital in leveraged positions and be cautious with new tech exposure given the macro headwinds.
plays: SOXL: Consider tightening your stop or reducing exposure. This leveraged chip ETF is down over 50% and decays, amplified by margin.
SPAL: Review your stop or trim this leveraged ETF. It's down over 30% and highly volatile, with margin increasing risk.
No new buys today - hold and watch. Macro conditions are unfavorable for new tech/chip longs, and scanner setups are mostly "chasing" or "in daily premium."
